title: PolicyDecision
description: Schema for policy enforcement decisions produced by M2 (Policy Enforcement & Micro-segmentation) and consumed by M1 (Identity & Context Engine) and M3 (Automated Response). Version 1.0 – frozen for Phase 1.

session_id.description: Session identifier this decision applies to.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this decision was made.

decision.description: Policy enforcement outcome. Semantics: allow=full access; step_up=MFA required; restrict=read-only/limited; deny=block session.

reason.description: Human-readable, audit-log-ready explanation for this decision.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live for this decision in seconds before M2 must re-evaluate. Drives the continuous re-evaluation loop.

applied_policies.description: Ordered list of policy rule IDs that were evaluated and applied.
